title: Extract the new account owner from a handover note
levels: Every field matches the source and the schema exactly
At least one field is missing, extra, of the wrong type or different from the source

cases.rationale: Every field matches the note, with owner_mobile and owner_title null because the note gives neither.
owner_title is "Account Manager", a title the note never gives, where the schema requires null.
It adds a working_days field that the schema does not list, where the object must hold exactly the nine specified fields.
All nine fields match the note in the required forms, including the two nulls; only the key order differs.
